newsitem.title: USA: Emerging debt mixed, Ecuador emerges as key gainer.
newsitem.headline: Emerging debt mixed, Ecuador emerges as key gainer.

text.p: Emerging debt prices ended mixed in quiet New York trading with Ecuador debt emerging as the key performer, traders said.
"Ecuador PDIs are up over one point...it's one of the better performers of the day," said one trader. "We've seen some repositioning from some U.S. accounts."
Ecuador Bradys were seen largely improved as interim president Fabian Alarcon began forming his government.
Ecuador PDIs gained 1-1/2 points to trade at 61-1/2 bid while Ecuador Pars rose 1/2 to trade at 46-1/4 bid.
